facts.fact: Maliweb reports that Mali's regulator AMRTP hosted the Alliance of Sahel States' second coordination meeting on military frequencies in border areas in Bamako, 2-4 November 2026, with Burkina Faso and Niger delegations.

Maliweb says a convention of 25 September 2026 between the regulators of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger created the Council of Sahel Regulators, after a coordination agreement signed in Ouagadougou on 21 November 2025 covering cybersecurity and roaming.
